messages.subject: index.html web forms for date
parts:
Hi 

I am trying to use index.html to take in dates and hours from the user and I am having some problems.
For hours as a number the index.html of 
 <input type="number" name="var">
and later

      Output Text
      <pre id="text1" class="shiny-text-output"></pre>

and then in server.R
data <- reactive({ 
...
dist(input$var)
  })

output$text1 <- renderText({
  paste("You have selected", input$var)
  })

displays the number input back in index.html fine. A html input of type text also works fine this way.
 
But when I replace the number input type with a date
<input type="date" name="var">
nothing gets displayed.

Am I going about this all wrong? Any help you can give me or just point me in the right direction would be great.
Date input work fine using ui.R. I am just wondering if there is a way to do they through index.html

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: index.html web forms for date
parts:
You want to use the same HTML that would be generated using dateInput in ui.R. You can always find out the HTML generated by a widget function by just executing it at an R console:

> library(shiny)
> dateInput("date", "Date")
<div id="date" class="shiny-date-input">
  <label class="control-label" for="date">Date</label>
  <input type="text" class="input-medium datepicker" data-date-language="en" data-date-weekstart="0" data-date-format="yyyy-mm-dd" data-date-start-view="month"/>
</div> 

Just do that and copy the HTML into your index.html file.
